'Ye tir hata deiṅ to ho jaaye karam maula': 'Ye tir hata deṅ to ho jaaye karam Maula',
'Abbas ke qaime meiṅ maula ne alam rakh ke': 'Abbas ke khaime mein Maula ne alam rakh ke',
'Kaati hai tanaabeiṅ yuṅ akbar ke abhi jaise': 'Kaati haiṅ tanaabeṅ yuṅ Akbar ke abhi jaise',
'Dafnaate hai ghazi ki hasrat meiṅ alam maula': 'Dafnaate haiṅ ghazi ki hasrat mein alam Maula',
}
lines = [line[2:] for line in roman.decode().splitlines()]

Audited every Roman verse against the Urdu in [hai-apni-sakina-ka.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/47243d6ea98245f8a7c546a67767ebec/src/data/lyrics/hai-apni-sakina-ka.md).
